events.title: US-Japan Joint FX Intervention Unraveling
events.description: US Treasury bought yen alongside Japan (~$75B Japan + $5-10B US), first US FX intervention in 15 years. Yen erased half its gains within 2 weeks. 30Y Treasury at 5.2%, highest since 2007. Intervention unraveling.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis - IRGC Closure, Ongoing US-Iran Conflict
events.description: IRGC closed Strait of Hormuz. US-Iran war ongoing. Tanker explosions reported. Trump claims control, Iran refutes. Brent at ~$89-93/bbl. EIA raised 2026 forecast to $87 avg. 0.6M bbl/day ongoing disruption through 2027.

events.title: Ebola Epidemic - DR Congo, Fastest-Growing on Record
events.description: 2026 Ebola epidemic in DR Congo. 4,053 confirmed cases, 1,850 deaths. Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Declared public health emergency. Existing treatments certified for Zaire strain only. On track to surpass deadliest outbreak in history.

events.title: UK Food Security Crisis - Drought + Hormuz Disruption
events.description: UK drought with 27M under hosepipe bans. Telegraph warns worst food security crisis in decades. Hormuz shipping disruption cutting fertiliser and food re-export routes. Ukraine grain export forecast cut to 38-40M tonnes from 43M.

events.title: China Property Crisis - $148B Expiring Lease Time Bomb
events.description: China racing to defuse $148B property threat from expiring leases. $190B non-residential property with leases of 20 years or less. PBOC maintaining loose monetary stance. China launching global tax hunt, capital flight controls.

events.title: South Korean Won - Sharpest Swings Since Financial Crisis
events.description: Won nearing 1,400/dollar after weakening to 1,550 in just over a month. Sharpest swings since 1997 Asian financial crisis. KOSPI rout driving retail investors back to US stocks. India rupee also under pressure.

events.title: US Fiscal Crisis Signals - 7.4% Deficit, 30Y at 5.2%
events.description: IMF forecasts US deficit 7.4%+ GDP through 2031. 30Y Treasury at 5.2%, highest since 2007. Telegraph: ingredients for US financial crisis. Private credit distress rising - PIK payments increasing. CBO: $3B daily debt interest.
